SELECT s.SINS_ID AS "wrterId", NVL(u.USER_NM, '사용자') AS "wrterNm", s.ISTSFDG AS "stsfdg", s.SSTSFDG_CN AS "content", SUBSTR(NVL(s.SUPD_DT, s.SINS_DT), 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(NVL(s.SUPD_DT, s.SINS_DT), 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(NVL(s.SUPD_DT, s.SINS_DT), 7, 2) AS "regDt" FROM TB_PROM_STSFDG s LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER u ON u.ESNTL_ID = s.SINS_ID WHERE s.IPROM_NO = #{promNo}
ORDER BY NVL(s.SUPD_DT, s.SINS_DT) DESC, s.SINS_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "cnt", ROUND(NVL(AVG(ISTSFDG), 0), 1) AS "avg" FROM TB_PROM_STSFDG WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_PROM_STSFDG t USING ( SELECT #{promNo} AS IPROM_NO, #{userId} AS SINS_ID FROM DUAL ) s ON ( t.IPROM_NO = s.IPROM_NO AND t.SINS_ID = s.SINS_ID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.ISTSFDG = #{stsfdg}, t.SSTSFDG_CN = #{stsfdgCn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.SUPD_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( IPROM_NO, SINS_ID, ISTSFDG, SSTSFDG_CN ) VALUES ( #{promNo}, #{userId}, #{stsfdg}, #{stsfdgCn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_PROM_STSFDG WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo} AND SINS_ID = #{userId}
mapper.sql:
WHERE ( p.SSTSFDG_YN = 'Y' OR a.IPROM_NO IS NOT NULL )
AND UPPER(REPLACE(p.STITLE, ' ', '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(REPLACE(#{keyword}, ' ', '')) || '%'

FROM TB_PROM p LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO ob ON ob.ORGNZT_ID = NVL(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(p.IBUSEO_NO), 16, '0')) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT s.IPROM_NO, COUNT(*) CNT, ROUND(AVG(s.ISTSFDG), 1) AVGV, MAX(NVL(s.SUPD_DT, s.SINS_DT)) LASTDT FROM TB_PROM_STSFDG s WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY s.IPROM_NO ) a ON a.IPROM_NO = p.IPROM_NO

FROM COMTNSTSFDG s JOIN COMTNBBS b ON b.NTT_ID = s.NTT_ID AND b.BBS_ID = s.BBS_ID JOIN COMTNBBSMASTER m ON m.BBS_ID = s.BBS_ID WHERE s.USE_AT = 'Y'
AND ( UPPER(REPLACE(b.NTT_SJ, ' ', '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(REPLACE(#{keyword}, ' ', '')) || '%' OR UPPER(REPLACE(m.BBS_NM, ' ', '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(REPLACE(#{keyword}, ' ', '')) || '%' )
GROUP BY s.BBS_ID, m.BBS_NM, s.NTT_ID, b.NTT_SJ, b.USE_AT

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum rn, TB.* FROM ( SELECT RTRIM(s.BBS_ID) AS "bbsId", m.BBS_NM AS "bbsNm", s.NTT_ID AS "nttId", b.NTT_SJ AS "title", b.USE_AT AS "articleUseAt", COUNT(*) AS "cnt", ROUND(AVG(s.STSFDG), 1) AS "avg", TO_CHAR(MAX(s.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "lastDt"
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(s.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM) DESC, s.NTT_ID DESC ) TB ) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{firstIndex}+1 AND #{firstIndex}+#{recordCountPerPage}

SELECT s.STSFDG_NO AS "stsfdgNo", NVL(u.USER_NM, s.WRTER_NM) AS "wrterNm", s.STSFDG AS "stsfdg", s.STSFDG_CN AS "content", TO_CHAR(s.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "regDt" FROM COMTNSTSFDG s LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER u ON u.ESNTL_ID = s.FRST_REGISTER_ID WHERE RTRIM(s.BBS_ID) = RTRIM(#{bbsId}) AND s.NTT_ID = #{nttId} AND s.USE_AT = 'Y'

SELECT p.STITLE AS "title", c.SNAME AS "cateNm", ob.ORGNZT_NM AS "buseoNm", p.ILAW_NO AS "lawNo", p.SEXISTING_YN AS "existingYn", NVL(u.USER_NM, '사용자') AS "wrterNm", s.ISTSFDG AS "stsfdg", s.SSTSFDG_CN AS "content", SUBSTR(NVL(s.SUPD_DT, s.SINS_DT), 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(NVL(s.SUPD_DT, s.SINS_DT), 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(NVL(s.SUPD_DT, s.SINS_DT), 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(NVL(s.SUPD_DT, s.SINS_DT), 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(NVL(s.SUPD_DT, s.SINS_DT), 11, 2) AS "regDt" FROM TB_PROM_STSFDG s JOIN TB_PROM p ON p.IPROM_NO = s.IPROM_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO ob ON ob.ORGNZT_ID = NVL(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(p.IBUSEO_NO), 16, '0')) LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER u ON u.ESNTL_ID = s.SINS_ID WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY p.STITLE, p.IPROM_NO DESC, NVL(s.SUPD_DT, s.SINS_DT)

SELECT m.BBS_NM AS "bbsNm", b.NTT_SJ AS "title", NVL(u.USER_NM, s.WRTER_NM) AS "wrterNm", s.STSFDG AS "stsfdg", s.STSFDG_CN AS "content", TO_CHAR(s.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "regDt", b.USE_AT AS "articleUseAt" FROM COMTNSTSFDG s JOIN COMTNBBS b ON b.NTT_ID = s.NTT_ID AND b.BBS_ID = s.BBS_ID JOIN COMTNBBSMASTER m ON m.BBS_ID = s.BBS_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER u ON u.ESNTL_ID = s.FRST_REGISTER_ID WHERE s.USE_AT = 'Y'
ORDER BY m.BBS_NM, b.NTT_ID, s.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM
